decisions.rationale: Vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor deficiency syndrome does not match the clinical presentation of progressive skin laxity and calcification of elastic fibers

option_relations.rationale: Vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor deficiency syndrome does not match the clinical presentation of progressive skin laxity and calcification of elastic fibers
Classic pseudoxanthoma elasticum is a subtype of pseudoxanthoma elasticum, which is characterized by calcification of elastic fibers and skin laxity
Classical Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum (PXE) is another term for pseudoxanthoma elasticum, which is characterized by calcification of elastic fibers and skin laxity

Pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with coagulation deficiency is a subtype of pseudoxanthoma elasticum, which is characterized by calcification of elastic fibers and skin laxity, with additional coagulation deficiency
